decision.summary: Cedar Homes reports the handle job complete but the invoice is unavailable and no visit is on record. I recorded the landlord's approval, asked the provider for the invoice, date and photos, asked the tenant to confirm, and put the job on hold to 14 Feb.

answers.answer: No. It is routine and waiting on information. Escalate only if the invoice is flagged on arrival.
